notes: ACCESS: robots.txt at https://www.potterybarn.com/robots.txt checked first - no Claude/Anthropic bot directives present (only EasouSpider and Pinterestbot named specifically); proceeded via Chrome tab only, no curl/WebFetch used. Country-redirect modal ('Looks like you're in India') was dismissed via 'No thanks, I'd like to proceed to the US site' to stay on the assigned USA storefront. TREE METHOD: single shared pass hovering every top-nav mega-menu (Bedding, Bath, Rugs, Windows, Pillows & Decor, Tabletop & Bar, Storage, Outdoor) and reading each menu's full link list via the accessibility tree (read_page), then opening every candidate leaf page to confirm its own H1 matches the requested node and to read the true item count. QTY METHOD: each leaf's own rendered 'NN Items' / 'View NN Items' text near the H1, extracted via a JS scan of the rendered page text after a render wait (never estimated/aggregated). EXCLUDED (view-all/collection/facet, not genuine subcategory leaves): 'All Bedding', 'All Rugs', 'All Curtains', 'All Window Shades', 'All Pillows Throws & Poufs', 'All Storage Furniture', 'All Storage & Organization', all 'In-Stock X', 'New Arrivals', 'Bestselling X', 'Collaborations', 'Basket Collections' (confirmed a curated-collections landing page, not a product listing), 'Organization Systems' and 'Modular Storage Collections' (both confirmed curated-collections pages via Products/Collections toggle), 'Rugs by Color' and 'Bedding by Color' and 'Window Treatments by Color' (pure color facets, not product-type subcategories), 'Rug Pads' (mounting accessory, not itself a floor textile). EXCLUDED as Furniture (breadcrumb and top-nav both confirmed 'Furniture' as the parent, despite appearing in the Storage mega-menu's 'Storage Furniture' column): 'Bookcases & Shelves', 'Storage Cabinets', 'Entryway Storage' (h1 is actually 'All Entryway Furniture'), 'Storage Benches & Ottomans'. EXCLUDED 'Poufs' (26 items) from Textile - site's own copy explicitly markets them as ottomans/seating furniture ('Poofs and Ottomans...extra seating or a footrest...large pouf ottomans can double as coffee tables'), so treated as Furniture per the Ottoman boundary rule despite fabric materials. EXCLUDED Fireplace & Hearth, Bath Vanities, Bath Furniture (vanities), Bath Lighting, Bath Hardware, Countertop Accessories, all Dinnerware/Flatware/Drinkware/Barware/Kitchen-tools nodes, all Decor/Wall Art/Mirrors/Botanicals nodes, and all Outdoor furniture/lounge/dining/lighting/planter nodes as out-of-scope for Textile/Storage (Furniture, Kitchen & Dining, Decorative Accessories, Lighting, or Wall Decor territory per each rule file's boundary sections). MIXED-CONTENT NODE: 'Outdoor Storage & Pool Towels' (/shop/outdoor/pool-storage/, 25 items) genuinely mixes pool-storage bins/organizers with pool towels under one listing and one qty; recorded in BOTH arrays at LOW confidence with a flag, since the site itself does not separate the two product types into different URLs/counts. 'Bath Robes & Slippers' (/shop/bath/robes/, 18 items) is majority robes (textile) but the same listing also contains a few slipper and eye-mask products; kept in Textile at MEDIUM confidence with a flag rather than split, since no separate robes-only URL/count exists. Rug-by-style nodes (Hand-Tufted, Hand-Knotted, Jute & Sisal, Wool, Patterned, Textured/Shag, Persian-Style, Solid, Performance) were included as genuine Textile subcategories per textile.md section 6's explicit examples (Shag Rugs, Handwoven Rugs, Flatweave Rugs, Kilims, etc.) even though their counts overlap with the general Area Rugs count, since they are the site's own standing navigational subcategories, not a color/price facet. Duplicate URLs collapsed to one row where the same link appeared in two menus (Baskets & Bins / Wastebaskets & Hampers appeared in both the Storage and Bath menus - kept once each, filed under Storage; Throws appeared in both Bedding and Pillows & Decor menus - kept once under Pillows, Throws & Poufs).
